message.content: Based on the conversation, JakeWatson believes Messi's impact on future generations of players is significant and far-reaching. He emphasizes that Messi's influence is not just limited to his own era but extends to the present and future as well. Jake expresses admiration for Messi's skills, but he places even greater value on his approach to the game. He notes that Messi sets a high standard not just through his abilities but also through his dedication, work ethic, and humility. Jake believes that young players today look up to Messi as a role model and that his legacy will continue to inspire future stars in the sport. He further states that Messi's influence shapes how future players play, indicating a lasting impact on the sport beyond his own career.
